item.text: The main issue is that most callers read `organization.plan` directly, while billing reads the subscription. I’m making organization reads return the subscription’s plan when one exists, so existing pages and service checks see the current plan even when stored records disagree. I’ll also make the trial sweep select only subscriptions still marked `trialing`, and resolve burst limits from the current subscription.
